description: This file provides ANSI escape sequences for coloring and formatting output in terminals, including functions for handling escape sequences, setting up color aliases, and patching composite escape sequences.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Returns ANSI escape sequence to move cursor up by n lines.

methods.name: strip_escapes
methods.description: Removes ANSI escape sequences from the input text.

methods.name: use_ansi_escape_colorbold_composites
methods.description: Patches escape sequences to handle color and bold composites correctly.
